name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, with a local LM Studio classifier and a classify tool.

backend.title: Classifier backend
backend.description: local: the Jev-style decision model served by LM Studio (no key, nothing leaves localBaseUrl). remote: TypeSafe's Jev API (needs the TypeSafe key).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for the remote backend. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage of the main conversation at which the plugin classifies it in the background (local backend) and then compacts it; subagents never trigger it.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

localBaseUrl.title: Local classifier URL
localBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the local classifier (local backend).

localModel.title: Local classifier model
localModel.description: Model identifier of the local Jev-style decision model as LM Studio lists it (local backend).

localConcurrency.title: Local classifier concurrency
localConcurrency.description: Decision requests in flight at once against the local server (local backend).

localContextTokens.title: Local classifier context tokens
localContextTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling for one local decision prompt; keep it under the context the model is loaded with (local backend).

classifyTool.title: Classify tool
classifyTool.description: Registers the classify tool (mcp__<plugin>__classify) for every agent: a local decision classifier on localBaseUrl/localModel that returns calibrated probabilities. Never uses TypeSafe.

localDeadlineMs.title: Local classifier time budget (ms)
localDeadlineMs.description: Longest a hook waits on the local model before answering with what it has. Claude Code drops a hook that runs past 10 s, so keep it under 10000.
